_note: Fictional lore for SuperiorJeet67. Used by the Random Achievement button and the terminal. Safe to edit.

discoveries.text: Rebuilt a dead 486 motherboard from Chor Bazaar scrap using solder from a temple lamp repair kit. Age nine. It booted.
Wrote a working x86 disassembler in QBasic because nobody would lend me a copy of IDA.
Designed C+++, a language with one extra plus because two was clearly not enough.
Founded MalwareMaharaja.onion. Age twelve. Most founders are thirty-five. Make of that what you will.
Hand-decoded a packed sample's control flow on graph paper during a 14-hour power cut.
Proved the 67th theorem. The first 66 were warmups. Proof available upon request to qualified readers.
Invented Negative-Day research: finding the vulnerability before the developer has the idea for the feature.
Launched JioCoin-X (₹CHAI). First consensus mechanism that requires you to out-negotiate the network.
Won a 9-hour reverse engineering debate by forfeit after my opponent's laptop died. I was still on 61%.
Sold the MalwareMaharaja operation. The figure is private. It was enough. It was more than enough.
Admitted to IIT Bombay. The entrance exam was the easiest system I have ever been asked to break, legally.
Began Nmap², a scanner that maps the network and also maps the people who configured it badly.
Established an undefeated intellectual record against Void. Still standing. Will always be standing.
Explained full RELRO in a Discord VC without opening Google. Two people left the call. Out of respect, presumably.
Currently developing tooling that will, in my estimation, change offensive security research permanently.

marketplace_items.name: Sanskar-Lock
marketplace_items.desc: File encryption utility with a custom key-derivation scheme. Considered unbreakable by its author and two customers.

marketplace_items.name: Betaji Ransomware (concept)
marketplace_items.desc: A ransomware concept that never shipped. The ransom note was a 4-page lecture on personal discipline. Victims would have learned something.

marketplace_items.name: Throne Protocol
marketplace_items.desc: Peer-to-peer messaging overlay where every node defers to the founder node. Decentralized, technically.

marketplace_items.name: Zero-Trust Burner
marketplace_items.desc: Hardened feature phone running a stripped custom firmware. Trusts nobody. Except me.

marketplace_items.name: Tiffin-Box Server Nodes
marketplace_items.desc: Low-power single-board servers inside stacked steel lunch tins. Passive cooling. Unbelievably good thermals.

marketplace_items.name: Darbar Router
marketplace_items.desc: OpenWrt-based travel router with a custom dashboard that greets the owner as 'Your Majesty'.

marketplace_items.name: Escrow-67
marketplace_items.desc: Multi-signature escrow for marketplace trades. The third signer was always me. Zero disputes I lost.
